A declaration-keyword grep over the whole file found 537 lines matching theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/elab/noncomputable, confirming declarations are dense throughout the file's span, not confined to the sampled regions. The junk-signal grep found 0 matches. The TODO/FIXME grep found 0 hits. No exclusions: the file stays searchable, consistent with the prior review's disposition to retain the lattice-triangle problem and solution artifacts as formal paper-related prior work.
